problems.text: The live HQ page is older than the page in the repo. Vercel deploys HQ only on request: the next work session deploys it (agents/devops.md).

decisions.title: Check free tools and search volume before an idea gets a pod
decisions.why: On 21 Nov 2026 all four ventures worked (formula-book, litter-log, lash-mapper, stem-count) died on the same two facts, each found only after a lead was staffed: a free no-account tool already did the job, and buyer search was 10 to 110 a month (company/ventures/*.json killReason).

options.option: Do nothing for now: keep screening with paid signals, a named gap and page one results only
options.basis: ap-company-2 screen passed formula-book, litter-log and stem-count, and all three were killed within one cycle of staffing (company/ventures/formula-book.json, litter-log.json, stem-count.json). No honest profit figure.

options.option: Before staffing a pod, Research runs two checks: a search for a free no-account web tool doing the exact job, and Google US volumes for buyer terms (DataForSEO via Firecrawl Alexandria); skip the idea if a free tool closes the gap or buyer terms total under about 500 a month
options.basis: The agents already pulled these volumes this cycle through Firecrawl Alexandria at no cash cost to the company, and the free tools that killed each idea (BreedTools, Stemwise, Lash Map Lab, Hair Notes) were found with a single search. Saves a pod cycle per weak idea. No honest profit figure since nothing has cleared a case yet.

options.option: Lower the business case bar so more ideas reach a build
options.basis: Would build products the case already says cannot reach paying buyers through search, the only allowed channel (CLAUDE.md). Output that earns nothing is not progress.

decision.choice: Before staffing a pod, Research runs two checks: a search for a free no-account web tool doing the exact job, and Google US volumes for buyer terms (DataForSEO via Firecrawl Alexandria); skip the idea if a free tool closes the gap or buyer terms total under about 500 a month
decision.reason: Same zero cost, fully reversible, and it moves the two facts that killed every idea this cycle to before a lead is staffed, so pods go only to ideas that can survive the case.

decisions.title: Main session runs the case reviewers when a lead cannot
decisions.why: 4 of 7 venture leads this week stopped blocked at validated because a lead session has no subagent tool (company/log/lead-*.json), so business cases waited a cycle or more.

options.option: Do nothing for now: leave it to the next cycle to notice blocked leads
options.basis: Leads for bake-cost, clean-quote, rally-rounds and master-key-gen all logged this block on 14 and 15 Nov 2026. No honest profit figure.

options.option: Make the Chief of Staff launch the independent reviewers from the main session as soon as a lead reports it needs them
options.basis: The main session has the subagent tool, and this already worked once: master-key-gen was decided in the same cycle on 15 Nov 2026. Keeps reviewers independent of the lead. No honest profit figure.

options.option: Let the lead write the case, sizing and CEO verdict itself
options.basis: Breaks the rule that a builder never reviews its own work (CLAUDE.md, RUNBOOK-daily.md).

decision.choice: Make the Chief of Staff launch the independent reviewers from the main session as soon as a lead reports it needs them
decision.reason: Removes a full cycle of delay at the business case gate at no cost, keeps every review independent, and is undone by reverting two charter lines.

decisions.title: Stop staffing ideas that have no allowed way to reach buyers
decisions.why: All 8 ideas worked on 14 Nov 2026 died because free tools already did the job and no allowed channel reached buyers.

options.option: Do nothing for now: keep picking ideas the same way
options.basis: 0 of 8 ideas cleared the bar on 2026-11-14; see killReason in company/ventures/bake-cost.json, rally-rounds.json, clean-quote.json, csv-qbo.json, shaadi-budget.json, donor-letters.json. No honest profit figure.

options.option: Screen every idea for an allowed channel and no free equivalent before staffing a pod; leave pods empty rather than staff weak ideas
options.basis: The agents can do it alone at no cost. No idea has cleared a business case yet, so no honest profit figure.

options.option: Ask the owner to share products with his own audience
options.basis: Breaks the CLAUDE.md rule against posting as the owner.

decision.choice: Screen every idea for an allowed channel and no free equivalent before staffing a pod; leave pods empty rather than staff weak ideas
decision.reason: Costs nothing, needs nothing from the owner, and stops cycles going to ideas that die the same way.

decisions.title: Take the stopped Seatwise product offline
decisions.why: Seatwise was stopped after its business case scored 11 of 35, but its free planner was still online. Only approved ideas may be live.

options.basis: Vercel pause_project blocks the production deployment and can be undone with unpause_project. Seatwise earns nothing (no payment set up, case 11 of 35).
Deleting projects is outside the decision limits in CLAUDE.md.
Leaves an idea online that was never approved, against the owner's rule that only approved ideas are deployed.

decision.reason: The owner wants only approved ideas deployed. Pausing takes Seatwise offline at no cost, keeps its code and project, and can be undone in one step.

decisions.title: Decide how to take payments once a product is ready
decisions.why: No product the company builds can earn money until there is a way to get paid. The agents cannot open a payment account for you.

options.option: Do nothing for now and decide again when a product clears its business case and sizing
options.basis: Both ideas assessed so far were stopped (Seatwise case 11 of 35, PayChase sizing Rs 14,723 expected a year), so there is nothing to sell and a payment account would earn Rs 0 now.

options.option: Ask the owner to open a Razorpay account now
options.basis: Razorpay needs the owner's own identity and bank details (KYC), which agents cannot provide, and nothing is ready to sell.

decision.choice: Do nothing for now and decide again when a product clears its business case and sizing
decision.reason: There is nothing to sell yet, so a payment account adds no profit today. When a product passes its business case, sizing and QA, the desk decides again; if the best option then needs the owner's identity it will ask him with plain steps.

decisions.title: Get past Cloudflare's injected scripts so products can launch
decisions.why: Cloudflare adds its own scripts to every page on your subdomains. They show errors, so no product can pass its launch check. It also goes against your rule of no proxies.

options.option: Keep Cloudflare as it is and have QA remove its two injected scripts before checking
options.basis: Tested 2026-11-14 with scripts/qa-check.js on https://seatwise.anchit-tandon.com and https://hq.anchit-tandon.com: 0 errors from the product at 390, 820 and 1440 px. Unblocks every launch; no product is ready yet, so no honest profit figure.

options.option: Ask the owner to switch the subdomains to DNS only in Cloudflare
options.basis: Needs the owner's Cloudflare login and a DNS change, and the wildcard record also serves his other live sites. The issue was closed on 2026-11-14 without the change being made.

options.option: Loosen each product's security rules to allow Cloudflare's scripts
options.basis: Cloudflare's bot check script changes on every request (3 requests gave 3 different hashes), so it can only be allowed with unsafe-inline, which weakens protection against script injection on every product.
Every product fails its launch check, so nothing can earn.

decision.choice: Keep Cloudflare as it is and have QA remove its two injected scripts before checking
decision.reason: It unblocks every launch today at no cost, keeps each product's security rules strict, needs nothing from the owner and can be undone in one commit. The DNS change needs the owner's login and touches his other sites.

ventures.title: Bake Cost
ventures.oneLiner: Recipe costing and price quote calculator for home bakers, on the phone, no install
ventures.customer: Home bakers and small cake sellers who price custom orders
ventures.revenueModel: Free single recipe, paid one-time unlock for saved recipes and quotes
ventures.killReason: Business case scored 15 of 35 (bar 24), with willingness to pay and distribution at 2: free no-signup cake pricing calculators already exist and paid costing apps barely sell. The only allowed channel, organic search, is crowded with free tools.

ventures.title: Mahj League
ventures.oneLiner: Web page that keeps weekly standings for American mahjong clubs and leagues, points only, no app install
ventures.customer: Organisers of American mahjong clubs, open play nights and leagues in the US
ventures.revenueModel: Paid season unlock per club; free single-game score sheet as the search magnet
ventures.nextAction: Validated by Navya on 2026-11-15. Needs: Research writes cases/mahj-league.md, Sizing writes cases/mahj-league.sizing.json, CEO go decision. Gap: league standings for American mahjong cost $57.99/mo at Mahjic Pro (free plan has no leagues) or need every player on an iPhone with a $2.99 MahWins purchase; no web, any phone, no install club standings tool found. Evidence against: (1) Mahjic, MahWins and AMR Authority are active, funded or shipping fast in this exact niche, and Mahjic claims 400+ clubs, so distribution is contested; (2) generic free web leaderboards exist (keepthescore free plan has 2 scoreboards, https://keepthescore.com/pricing), so a casual club can make do; (3) PartyPot offers free club season leaderboards for game groups (https://partypotapp.com.advisoryapps.com/business/leaderboard/); (4) the paid leagues found are small local 4 week events, so per club willingness to pay for a tool is unproven, and the leagues found already chose an app; (5) no sourced search volume found for league terms (mahjong league scoring, mahjong league score sheet); page one for those is Etsy printables, a NZ club PDF, mahjong4friends.com and mahjongg.ai.studio, so small sites can rank but the volume may be tiny. Research must quantify volume before the case clears. Legal: points only, never money or stakes, never reproduce the NMJL card.
ventures.killReason: Business case scored 14 of 35 (bar 24; willingnessToPay 2 and distribution 2, both need 3): free apps AMR Authority and PartyPot already keep mahjong league standings, no sourced search volume for league terms, and no payment rail.

ventures.title: Seatwise
ventures.oneLiner: Plan a wedding seating chart on your phone in minutes, private, no signup
ventures.customer: Couples and family members planning a wedding or large event seating
ventures.revenueModel: Free planner, one-time paid Pro unlock (price pending owner approval)
ventures.nextAction: None. Parked. Code kept in ventures/seatwise.
ventures.killReason: Business case scored 11 of 35 (bar 24): free no-signup seating tools already exist, most Indian weddings do not use assigned tables, and there is no way to reach paying buyers without ads or posting. Built free planner parked, not launched.

ventures.title: ACH Batch
ventures.oneLiner: Build a bank-ready NACHA ACH payment file from a spreadsheet of payees in the browser, nothing uploaded
ventures.customer: US small businesses and bookkeepers paying contractors or payroll by ACH through their bank
ventures.revenueModel: Monthly subscription in USD, first file free
ventures.killReason: Removed at the weekly review: the tool would build files that move real money from bank account numbers, so one wrong file can misdirect payments, a real risk to users that the product rules keep us out of. Legal held it for that reason, some banks already take a plain CSV (Chase), and PayFile Pro already fills the browser gap cheaply.

ventures.title: Clean Quote
ventures.oneLiner: Instant house cleaning price quote builder for solo cleaners, shareable link
ventures.customer: Solo and small house cleaning businesses
ventures.revenueModel: Paid one-time pro unlock
ventures.killReason: Business case scored 16 of 35 (bar 24), with distribution at 2 and recurring revenue at 1: Jobber, Housecall Pro and ShiftFlow give free cleaning calculators and quote templates. There is no allowed channel to reach solo cleaners without ads, outreach or the owner Etsy identity.

ventures.title: Donor Letters
ventures.oneLiner: Year-end giving statements for every donor from one spreadsheet or QuickBooks export, printed or emailed as PDFs
ventures.customer: Small US churches and nonprofits that track gifts in QuickBooks or a spreadsheet
ventures.revenueModel: Annual season pass per organisation in USD, priced per batch of statements
ventures.nextAction: None. Killed at validating, see killReason, evidence and evidenceAgainst.
ventures.killReason: Killed at validating. The need is real (QuickBooks has no donor statements, paid apps exist), but the exact product is already free: CharityCharge turns a gift CSV into annual donor summaries in the browser at no cost, B1.church and Zeffy produce year-end statements free, and the nearest paid spreadsheet tool (Statement Press) charges only $29 a year with a free tier. Organic search is the only allowed channel and it is already crowded with free generators, and the season closes by late January, leaving about ten weeks to build, rank and sell. Same pattern that killed earlier ideas: free tools already do the job.

ventures.title: Lash Mapper
ventures.oneLiner: Build a lash extension map on your phone by tapping each zone for length, curl and thickness, saved per client and printable
ventures.customer: Lash extension technicians
ventures.revenueModel: Paid one-time unlock
ventures.nextAction: None. Killed at the business case.
ventures.killReason: Business case scored 14 of 35 (bar 24; willingnessToPay 2 and distribution 2, both need 3). Free tools close the gap: Lash Map Lab is a free web lash map generator with no sign up, LashMap Studio is free up to 20 clients, and Lash Dash keeps per client maps for USD 3.99 a month. The 33,100 lash map volume was RankHero Etsy data, not Google; tech intent Google searches are small (about 1,550 a month in the US) and tool terms have no measurable volume. No payment rail.

ventures.title: Paychase
ventures.oneLiner: Polite payment reminder sequence and overdue tracker for Indian freelancers
ventures.customer: Indian freelancers with clients who pay late
ventures.revenueModel: One-time template and tracker purchase
ventures.killReason: Market sizing: about 271 paying people and Rs 14,723 expected a year against a bar of Rs 3,00,000, with a 10% chance of working against a bar of 15%. Zoho Invoice and Refrens already send payment reminders free, and late payment hits most freelancers about once a year, so a one-time Rs 499 tool has little room. Stopped before any build.

problem.who: Indian freelancers and very small service businesses (designers, developers, writers, marketers, small agencies) whose clients pay invoices after the due date, and who find it awkward to chase. Most of them already have a free invoicing tool that sends reminders, so the unmet need is narrow: the wording and the nerve to send reminder 2 and 3, not the sending itself.

cohorts.name: Indian high-skilled gig workers and freelancers billing domestic clients
US freelancers doing skilled knowledge work
Indian micro and small businesses escalating late payment on MSME Samadhaan (weakest cohort)

ventures.title: Rally Rounds
ventures.oneLiner: Pickleball round robin schedules and live scores for club organisers, no app install
ventures.customer: Volunteer pickleball and padel session organisers
ventures.revenueModel: Free for small sessions, paid organiser pass
ventures.killReason: Business case scored 14 of 35 (bar 24), with willingness to pay and distribution at 2 and competition gap at 1: Reclub and others already give free browser round robins with live scores. Search intent leans free, and the paying money sits with networked brands like Pickleheads.

ventures.title: Shaadi Budget
ventures.oneLiner: Indian wedding budget planner by function and vendor, works offline
ventures.customer: Indian families planning a wedding
ventures.revenueModel: One-time paid planner
ventures.nextAction: None. Killed at validating: free tools already cover budget by function and vendor in INR.
ventures.killReason: Free everywhere and no allowed channel. The need is real (average budget Rs 36.5 lakh) but WeddingWire India, a free Hindi per-event planner, Calcwise and another free tracker already do budget by function and vendor in INR at no cost. The paid Indian specific tools found show near zero traction (8 ratings, 10+ downloads, a USD 1.99 template), and organic search for this need is crowded by WeddingWire, WedMeGood and many free SEO tool pages. Same failure pattern as earlier ideas.

ventures.title: Stem Count
ventures.oneLiner: Phone tool for freelance event florists: enter each arrangement recipe and quantity, get the stems rounded up to wholesale bunches, the flower order and a priced client quote
ventures.customer: Freelance and small studio wedding and event florists
ventures.revenueModel: Free stem counter page, paid one-time unlock for saved events, wholesale order sheet and client quote PDF
ventures.nextAction: None. Killed on 21 Nov 2026; see killReason. Lesson for screening: check Stemwise, Magnaflor and Fiory free calculators before staffing any florist tool, and pull DataForSEO volumes before staffing.
ventures.killReason: Killed in validation on 21 Nov 2026 by lead Diya. Florists do pay for recipe and pricing software (Details Flowers $25 to $150 a month, Curate from $275 a month, EveryStem, a $197 spreadsheet pack, a $17 Stan calculator), but the free no account part of the job is already done: Stemwise has a free phone ready wedding stem calculator with a buy-in buffer, bunch rounding from your own bunch size, a budget from cost per stem, a share link and a print PDF (https://getstemwise.com/tools/wedding-flower-calculator.html); Magnaflor gives florists free stems, bunches and boxes rounded to real pack sizes (https://magnaflor.com/resources/wedding-calculator); Fiory.AI Lens gives a free recipe with markup and retail price (https://www.fiory.ai/lens); Details Flowers, Florist App, Harvest and Verdnatura give free markup calculators. The only gap left is per variety recipe lines rounded to per variety bunches on a branded client quote, which is what the paid suites sell and is too narrow to win on a free page. Search, our only channel, is tiny where intent is florist: US Google Ads monthly averages for the last 12 months from DataForSEO (keywords/search-volume, location 2840, language en, pulled 21 Nov 2026 through Firecrawl Alexandria) are floral pricing calculator 40, flower stem calculator 30, florist proposal software 20, florist pricing formula 10, and null (too small to report) for stem count calculator, florist stem calculator, flower recipe calculator, wedding flower recipe template, florist pricing calculator, how many stems for wedding, wedding flower stem count, floral recipe template, florist recipe software, stem count template, flower bunch calculator, how many stems per bunch and stems per bunch. The bigger terms are couple intent: wedding flower cost calculator 210 and wedding flower calculator 110, where page one already has free calculators from Magnaflor, Stemwise, Blooming More, Artemis Flower Farm, Los Angeles Floral Couture and Heirloom Soul. Realistic first year revenue through search alone is near zero. This repeats the clean-quote and litter-log pattern: a free no account tool already does the job and buyer searches run 10 to 40 a month.

ventures.title: CSV to QBO
ventures.oneLiner: Turn any bank or card CSV into a QBO, QFX or OFX file for QuickBooks in the browser, nothing uploaded
ventures.customer: US bookkeepers and small business owners importing bank history into QuickBooks
ventures.revenueModel: Monthly subscription in USD after a free first file
ventures.nextAction: None. Killed at validating; no business case or spec needed.
ventures.killReason: The need is real (DocuClipper from $29 a month, ProperSoft from $19.99 a month) but at least four free in-browser, no-upload converters already do exactly this job (Statement Extract free forever unlimited, Ledgerbridge, FileTailored, Somacon for IIF), and QuickBooks Online imports CSV natively. Our pitch of in-browser, nothing uploaded is already the free incumbents pitch, and organic search, our only allowed channel, is crowded with them. Same failure pattern as earlier ideas: free tools already do the job and there is no channel.

ventures.title: Formula Book
ventures.oneLiner: Phone notebook for hair colourists to save each client's colour formula and history, offline, with a file export
ventures.customer: Independent and booth-rent hair colourists
ventures.revenueModel: Paid one-time unlock
ventures.nextAction: None. Killed: no rankable search demand for formula tracking terms (about 10 US searches a month or less each) and the exact gap is already filled by Hair Notes. Revisit only if a measurable search term with buyer intent appears.
ventures.killReason: Killed in validating on 21 Nov 2026 by lead Tanvi: people do pay for formula apps (Gloss 622 ratings at $3.99 a month, Charm, FyleStyle, ShadeFile), but there is no search route our own pages can win. DataForSEO Google Ads US volume (Firecrawl Alexandria, Nov 2025 to Oct 2026): hair color formula app 10 a month, colorist app 10, hair color client record card 10, client card template hair salon 10, hair stylist client book 30, salon client record card 20; hair color formula tracker, color formula card, hair color formula card, client formula log template, hair color formula book and hair formula app all have no measurable volume. Page one for hair color formula app is entirely App Store listings. The only terms with volume (hair color formula 260, hair color mixing calculator 260) are informational and already full of free calculators and Goldie. The exact product we planned (offline, one-time price, export) already exists as Hair Notes at $3.99 and has 2 ratings, and new entrants (ShadeFile, Blendsor, ColorBowl) show the space is crowded with little traction. Search-only distribution cannot reach enough buyers.

ventures.title: Litter Log
ventures.oneLiner: Phone log for small dog breeders: whelping times, daily puppy weights with growth charts and a buyer-ready puppy record
ventures.customer: Small hobby dog breeders with one to five litters a year
ventures.revenueModel: Paid one-time unlock
ventures.nextAction: None. Killed on 21 Nov 2026; see killReason. Lesson for screening: check for a free no account tool on the exact job (here BreedTools) before staffing.
ventures.killReason: Killed in validation on 21 Nov 2026 by lead Yash. The gap is already closed for free: BreedTools runs a free, no account, on device litter weight tracker with a growth chart per puppy and printable records (https://breedtools.com/tools/weight-tracker), and it ranks on page one for whelping calculator; Puppy Scales is a free app that does the same (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1579589173); EZwhelp gives free whelping and litter weight forms (https://www.ezwhelp.com/pages/whelping-forms). This overturns the earlier gap item that said no free tracker charts weights per puppy. Search, our only channel, is too small where intent is breeder: US Google Ads monthly averages for the last 12 months from DataForSEO (keywords/search-volume, location 2840, pulled 21 Nov 2026 through Firecrawl Alexandria) are whelping chart 110, puppy weight tracker 40, whelping record 30, puppy weight tracker app 10, litter tracker 10, litter weight chart 10, newborn puppy weight chart 10, and null for litter record template and puppy weight log. The bigger terms are owner intent and owned by brands: puppy growth chart 4400 and puppy weight chart 880, where page one is Waltham, Iams, Sydney Animal Hospitals, puppyweights.com, AKC, Omni Calculator and Pearson; whelping calculator 390 is a due date tool, already served free by gundogcentral, BreedTools, Leerburg and others. Paid signals are thin: Whelper 17 ratings, Breedera 38 ratings, Breeder Tracker and Puppy Tracker too few ratings to show, and Etsy breeder templates sell at $1.29 to $9.99. Search results are also full of parasite template pages on high authority university and government domains, which a new subdomain cannot outrank soon. Realistic first year revenue through search alone is near zero.

ventures.title: Master Key Generator
ventures.oneLiner: Build a master key system for pin tumbler locks in the browser: printable bitting list and pinning chart with MACS and pin stack checks
ventures.customer: Small locksmith shops, facility maintenance staff and landlords who master key their own pin tumbler locks, US first
ventures.revenueModel: Free build and preview, paid per downloadable chart or a low price unlimited pass, in USD
ventures.killReason: Killed at validating. People do pay (CLK charts $10.15, Aero Key $120, HPC MasterKing $340.68), but Key-En-Lock launched a free Master Key System Builder on 22 Feb 2026 that already covers Schlage C, Kwikset KW1, Yale, Corbin Russwin and Best SFIC with pinning and bitting chart PDFs (https://keyenlock.com/blog/master-key-system-builder/), ABUS gives a free designer, and demand evidence is small and old (paid apps with 7 to 19 ratings, forum requests from 2006 to 2018). Fails screen (b) of issue 7.

ventures.title: Stall Tally
ventures.oneLiner: Craft fair sales and stock tally for makers at market stalls, works offline
ventures.customer: Makers selling at craft fairs and weekend markets
ventures.revenueModel: Paid one-time unlock
ventures.nextAction: Research. Against: Booth Math and VendStats apps already exist (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6770763212)

ventures.title: Golf League Desk
ventures.oneLiner: Phone web tool for weekly golf league secretaries: league handicaps, weekly pairings, points and standings, shared as a read-only link
ventures.customer: Volunteer secretaries of small weekly golf leagues (9 hole after work, men's and women's club leagues) in the US
ventures.revenueModel: Free handicap and standings page, paid one season unlock for a full league
ventures.killReason: A free tool already does the whole job. Squabbit Free (5.6K App Store ratings at 4.9, web app included) runs unlimited leagues with custom league handicaps and subs, every scoring format including match play points, tee time preferences, recurring weekly events, live season standings and a public read-only event website at no cost; its paid League Pro ($249.99 a year) only adds stats, sponsors and admin polish. Golf League Guru and GOWF are further free league apps. Paid demand is real (GolfSoftware $8 per golfer a year, Golf League Network up to $570 to $630 a league, Golf League Tracker $119 a league a season), but those buyers already have a free full-league option from a well rated brand, and page one for golf league software is held by those vendors plus Capterra and the App Store. Our only gap would be no account, which is not a reason to pay. Search is also seasonal (70 to 110 a month in Sep to Oct). Killed 21 Nov 2026 under ap-company-1 and ap-company-4: a free tool closes the gap.

ventures.title: Sitter Sheet
ventures.oneLiner: Pet sitter client intake, visit report and invoice in one phone page
ventures.customer: Independent pet sitters and dog walkers
ventures.revenueModel: Paid one-time unlock
ventures.nextAction: Research: paid pet sitter form packs on vendor pages. Against: free form builders exist (Paperform, Makeform)

ventures.title: Class Pass Card
ventures.oneLiner: Digital punch card for independent yoga and fitness instructors selling class packs
ventures.customer: Independent yoga, dance and fitness instructors
ventures.revenueModel: Paid monthly or one-time unlock

ventures.title: Rota Sheet
ventures.oneLiner: Printable weekly staff rota for tiny shops and cafes
ventures.customer: Owners of small shops and cafes with under 10 staff
ventures.revenueModel: Paid printable rota pack
ventures.nextAction: Rescored at the weekly review: distribution 3 to 2, because under the search-only rule our page would have to outrank free rota tools from Findmyshift and BrightHR (https://www.findmyshift.co.uk/free-staff-rota-software). Research only if a paid gap the free tools miss is found.

office.name: Arya
office.title: Chief Executive
